lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: STOP SCRUBBING THE FLOOR AND LOOK AT ME [beat] BEFORE I LOSE MY COOL COMPLETELY AND THROW THIS SOAPY BUCKET AT YOU!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You should be thanking me Bruno [beat] because without this job you would be facing a permanent expulsion for that midnight scooter stunt.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I only took that stupid scooter because my little brother was sick [beat] and I didn't have any other way to get to the pharmacy!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: A noble reason does not excuse the mud you tracked into the auditorium [beat] but Nix told me everything about your family's situation.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I even paid for the broken kickstand myself [beat] so you don't have to worry about the repair costs hanging over your head anymore.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You paid for it [beat] even after I spent the last three years making your life a living nightmare in every single class we had?

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Nix says that holding a grudge is way too expensive [beat] and helping people is the only way to make sure the bullying finally stops!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I don't know what to say [beat] I guess I owe you more than just a clean floor for looking out for me when nobody else would.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Just consider it an investment in a better school [beat] and maybe try being the guy who protects people instead of the guy who scares them.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: If you work hard this week [beat] I might even consider letting you back onto the varsity football team for the spring season.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I’ll have this place shining like a diamond by tomorrow morning [beat] and Nix, I’m truly sorry for being such a massive jerk to you.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't mention it [beat] just make sure you don't miss a spot under the bleachers because the head janitor is very strict about his floors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that’s how the school bully became the head janitor's assistant [beat] proving that in Nix’s world, kindness is the only currency that always pays off.
